educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn English that is used in business situations by setting the course in a (role-play) company. Students will learn vocabulary and phrases by completing business tasks and be expected to use them effectively. By participating in group activities, in addition to the four skills of speaking, listening, reading, and writing, students will learn the skills necessary for completing business situations through activities such as presentations, discussions, interviews, and role plays.
advice: 1. In order to learn English that is used in business situations, the majority of class will be conducted through group work. When completing projects, it will be necessary to work together with the other members of the group. 2. Group work includes activities such as presentations and discussions. English will be used for these activities. 3. While doing group work, each student must actively participate and contribute to complete the activities. - Students must try their best to use only English during class. - Students must actively participate in group activities. - Students must bring a Japanese-English dictionary to every class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar is necessary.

activityGoals.body: Learn vocabulary and phrases used in the workplace and use them appropriately in business settings.
Learn how to do business tasks such as market research, presentations, and advertisement making.
Understand the differences between Japanese and foreign business cultures and appropriately apply them.
Learn the foundations of digital literacy and appropriately apply them.
